capabilities: Display emojis next to note and folder titles in the File Explorer and navigation tabs
Resolve emojis from frontmatter fields, folder-note inheritance, or file extension
Automatically create and sync folder notes for directory metadata
Suspend emoji injection during sidebar renames to avoid corrupting new names
Configure default fallback emojis per file type in settings
extras: The README notes the plugin was refactored into a modular code structure for maintainability and includes local build instructions.
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer shows only plain file and folder names, making notes and folders harder to tell apart at a glance.

relations.evidence: Folders with Folder Notes configured with apply_to_children: true (or inherit_emoji: true)

summary: File-explorer decorator that adds emojis to note and folder titles in the File Explorer and navigation tabs based on frontmatter, folder inheritance, or file type.
